notes: The *when* could instead have been given to the apodosis waw s010, but it stands at the head of the clause s001's waw opens, so rule 55's pair reading governs and s010 is the unrendered connective under rule 14.

s007 is a finite perfect, so its *was* is the verb's own auxiliary under rule 17 rather than a construction-supplied copula; the unit's tokens and head are unaffected, since either reading puts *was dead* on that verb headed on *dead*.

s016/s017/s018: the rectum הַמַּמְלָכָה is rendered attributively and anarthrously as *royal*, so the phrase's single *the* is the article's fronted determiner under rule 29 and the construct keeps only *seed*.
